behavior: Hunts almost exclusively by plunge-diving feet-first into water to catch fish, often hovering briefly before the strike; carries prey head-forward for aerodynamic flight; migratory across much of its range, with some populations traveling thousands of kilometers between breeding and wintering grounds.
field_marks: Dark brown upperparts contrasting with mostly white underparts and head
Distinctive dark eye-stripe extending from bill through the eye to the nape
Long, narrow wings with a pronounced dark carpal patch, often held bowed or crooked in flight (M-shape)
White crown and throat with a mottled dark brown necklace band across the chest, more pronounced in females
Sharply hooked black bill and pale yellow eyes
Long, bare, pale bluish-grey legs with reversible outer toes and spiny footpads for gripping fish
habitat: Found near rivers, lakes, reservoirs, coastal estuaries, and other bodies of water with abundant fish; requires nearby tall trees, cliffs, or man-made structures for nesting and perching.
